validation_config.query:
SELECT count(*) AS successful_updates
FROM customer_case
WHERE case_id IN (397, 398, 399, 415, 416, 400, 401, 402, 403, 404, 405)
  AND priority = 'critical'
  AND assigned_to = 4;
